Stay up to date with our twitter: https://bit.ly/2WSbbgh Neil Erikson and his group Patriot Blue had a busy Australia Day. It started at Moreland City Council with their handing out of flyers to new Australian citizens about being Australian and warning them about un-Australian Councils like Moreland. They then travelled to the CBD to see what the Invasion Day protestors were up to.

They also visited the True Blue Crew Beach Party. Associate Editor of The Unshackled Tom Pirrone caught up with Neil and asked him to give a summary of his day.
